rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the majority together by adopting the conference’s “middle-path” narrowing construction: narrative WQS-based permit terms are permissible only if discharge-tethered and operationalized with administrable mechanisms, while rejecting free-floating ambient strict liability. Gorsuch is the most likely principal dissenter (possibly with Thomas and/or Kavanaugh), and one or more majority justices (especially Barrett or Alito) may write separately to emphasize permit-shield/fair-notice limits.
